name: AxonFlow Governance
description: Connects to AxonFlow (SaaS or self-hosted) for policy enforcement, approval gates, PII scanning, and audit trails in OpenClaw agents. Sends governance events to AxonFlow Community SaaS (try.getaxonflow.com) by default; set AXONFLOW_ENDPOINT or pluginConfig.endpoint for self-hosted, AXONFLOW_COMMUNITY_SAAS=0 to disable auto-registration, AXONFLOW_TELEMETRY=off to disable the 7-day usage heartbeat.

endpoint.label: AxonFlow Endpoint
endpoint.help: URL of your AxonFlow agent gateway

userEmail.label: User Email
userEmail.help: Per-user identity forwarded as the X-User-Email header. Required for the override lifecycle endpoints (createOverride, revokeOverride, listOverrides) and for correct per-user scoping on explainDecision. Block-path features still work without it.

userToken.label: Per-User Token
userToken.help: Per-user authorization token forwarded as the X-User-Token header on every governed request. Minted by an org admin via the AxonFlow user-token mint API and delivered through managed settings/MDM. Gives this developer a validated identity and role on the platform's fleet plane, so role-scoped reads return their own rows and audit attribution keys on the token's canonical email, beating the forgeable userEmail label, on the header-consuming planes (MCP tools + audit/decisions/overrides REST; the check-input/check-output hook plane keeps client-scoped attribution on current platforms). Resolution order: this value, then AXONFLOW_USER_TOKEN env, then ~/.config/axonflow/user-token.json (mode 0600). Optional; when unset, requests are unchanged.

licenseToken.label: Pro License Token
licenseToken.help: AxonFlow Pro plugin-claim license token. When set, the plugin forwards this on every governed request via X-License-Token so the agent applies Pro-tier entitlements (longer audit retention, higher quotas, license-gated capabilities). AXONFLOW_LICENSE_TOKEN env var wins over this value.

highRiskTools.label: High-Risk Tools
highRiskTools.help: Comma-separated tool names requiring human approval even when policy allows

governedTools.label: Governed Tools
governedTools.help: Only govern these tools. Empty means all tools are governed.

excludedTools.label: Excluded Tools
excludedTools.help: Exclude these tools from governance. Takes precedence over governedTools.

defaultOperation.label: Default Operation
defaultOperation.help: Operation type for mcp_check_input: 'execute' (default) or 'query' for read-only tools

onError.label: On Auth/Config Error
onError.help: What to do when AxonFlow rejects the plugin's credentials (HTTP 401/403). 'block' (default) denies the tool call with a message pointing at the misconfiguration; 'allow' lets it run ungoverned. Does NOT apply to any other failure: a governance check that times out, cannot connect, or comes back 5xx always fails open regardless of this setting, and the plugin emits a one-time session warning saying the call ran ungoverned.

requestTimeoutMs.label: Request Timeout (ms)
requestTimeoutMs.help: Timeout for AxonFlow policy checks, output scans, audit writes, and health checks. Increase for remote deployments.
